name: shardflux
description: Persistent cloud workspaces for AI agents: run commands, servers, builds and a browser in a Linux computer that keeps its files and processes between sessions.

interface.longDescription: Give Codex a persistent cloud computer. Codex opens a Shardflux workspace by key and runs commands, dev servers, builds, tests and a Chromium browser in it. The workspace keeps its files, packages and running processes between sessions, suspends when idle and wakes on the next call. Forks copy a workspace, memory included, for risky changes.
defaultPrompt: Clone my repo into a Shardflux workspace called my-app, install it and run the tests
Start the dev server in my Shardflux workspace in the background and take a screenshot of it
